description:
FILED s543l (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24) while widening the #3370 hoist's precondition for #5330.  PRE-EXISTING (base 9fc6583b = MAIN-READY-110's code).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | ./runpcl on 9fc6583b):
    our $g = 1;
    { my @t = @{[ local $g = 8 ]}; print "in=$g t=@t\n" }
    print "out=$g\n";
    { my $n = ${ \ (local $g = 7) }; print "in2=$g n=$n\n" }
  perl: in=1 t=8 / out=1 / in2=1 n=7
  PCL:  in=8 t=8 / out=1 / in2=7 n=7

WHAT IT IS: a DEREF block (`@{ ... }`, `${ ... }`, `%{ ... }`) is a SCOPE in perl: a `local` inside it is restored when
the deref block is left.  The #3370 hoist treats the deref block as part of the expression (Parser2::_hoist_local_term,
"a DEREF block `@{local X}` is part of the expression") and moves `local X;` before the whole statement, so the
restore is the ENCLOSING block's end.  Rare (an anonymous constructor holding a local inside a deref).

s543l keeps its #5330 widening (value operators, element commas, an other-key delete) OUT of a deref block for this
reason; the old first-term hoist there is unchanged.  FIX DIRECTION: a local term inside a deref block lowers through
the embedded-block path with its own restore at the block's exit (the deref block's statements are a block the v2
lowering can wrap: `(let ... (p-local-* ... VALUE))`), or the hoist declines there and the term is refused (LOUD, not
silent) -- measure the population first (`@{[ ... local ... ]}` sites in the four populations).
frequency_reason: a `local` inside a dereference block (first pass from the subject, the reviewing session 2026-11-24)
subject: SILENT WRONG (rare): a `local` inside a DEREF block (`@{[ local $g = 8 ]}`, `${ \ (local $g = 7) }`) is restored at the ENCLOSING block's end -- perl restores it when the deref block is left (the #3370 hoist moves it before the statement)
triage_reason: a local inside a deref block restores at the enclosing block
